constraints.definition: CHECK ((((planned_status = 'planejado'::sanitario_agenda_animal_v2_status_enum) AND (execution_evento_id IS NULL) AND (NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(not_executed_reason, ''::text)), ''::text) IS NULL)) OR ((planned_status = 'executado'::sanitario_agenda_animal_v2_status_enum) AND (execution_evento_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((planned_status = 'nao_executado'::sanitario_agenda_animal_v2_status_enum) AND (execution_evento_id IS NULL) AND (NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(not_executed_reason, ''::text)), ''::text) IS NOT NULL))))

PRIMARY KEY (agenda_id, animal_id)
CHECK ((btrim(dedup_key) <> ''::text))

CHECK ((((closure_type = ANY (ARRAY['executed_with_event'::sanitario_agenda_closure_v2_type_enum, 'partially_executed_with_event'::sanitario_agenda_closure_v2_type_enum])) AND (execution_evento_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((closure_type = ANY (ARRAY['closed_without_execution'::sanitario_agenda_closure_v2_type_enum, 'cancelled'::sanitario_agenda_closure_v2_type_enum, 'dismissed'::sanitario_agenda_closure_v2_type_enum])) AND (execution_evento_id IS NULL))))

CHECK (((closure_type <> 'partially_executed_with_event'::sanitario_agenda_closure_v2_type_enum) OR ((jsonb_typeof((partial_payload -> 'executed_animal_ids'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length((partial_payload -> 'executed_animal_ids'::text)) > 0) AND (jsonb_typeof((partial_payload -> 'not_executed_animals'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length((partial_payload -> 'not_executed_animals'::text)) > 0))))

CHECK (((closure_type <> ALL (ARRAY['closed_without_execution'::sanitario_agenda_closure_v2_type_enum, 'cancelled'::sanitario_agenda_closure_v2_type_enum, 'dismissed'::sanitario_agenda_closure_v2_type_enum])) OR (NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(reason, ''::text)), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)))

CHECK ((btrim(acao_sanitaria) <> ''::text))
CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['cancelada'::sanitario_agenda_v2_status_enum, 'dispensada'::sanitario_agenda_v2_status_enum])) OR (execution_evento_id IS NULL)))
CHECK (((data_programada >= janela_inicio) AND ((janela_fim IS NULL) OR (data_programada <= janela_fim))))
CHECK ((btrim(dedup_key) <> ''::text))
CHECK (((execution_evento_id IS NULL) OR (status = 'fechada'::sanitario_agenda_v2_status_enum)))
CHECK (((janela_fim IS NULL) OR (janela_fim >= janela_inicio)))
CHECK ((revision >= 0))
